reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_rejected` -> `envoy_cilium_npds_update_rejected`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The rejected-update metric is now published as `envoy_cilium_npds_update_rejected` instead of `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_rejected`.
consequence.remediation: Change any monitoring queries, dashboards or alerts that use the old metric name to use `envoy_cilium_npds_update_rejected`.

proposed.statement: In Cilium 1.17 the Envoy metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_rejected` was renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_update_rejected`.
